name: Verdurous-Eyot

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near an ancient meteor crater that no expedition has ever claimed.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on platinum, salvageable alloys, uranium and silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
